title: SkillBuffBench: Measuring What Agent Skills Contribute across Harnesses, Models, Skill Access Modes and Memory
abstract: arXiv:2611.22017v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent Skills, file-based packages of procedural knowledge that a coding agent can discover and load on demand, are now shipped by every major agent harness, yet the evidence for how much they help comes almost entirely from settings in which the right Skill is hand-picked for the task and the agent starts from a blank slate. Neither holds in deployment, where an agent chooses from whatever library happens to be installed and frequently carries memory from earlier work. translated_title: SkillBuffBench：衡量智能体技能在框架、模型、技能访问模式与记忆等方面的贡献
translated_abstract: 智能体技能是一类基于文件的程序性知识包，编码智能体可以按需发现并加载，目前各大主流智能体框架均已支持。然而，关于技能能带来多大帮助的证据，几乎完全来自这样的设定：为任务人工挑选正确的技能，且智能体从空白状态开始。这两点在真实部署中都不成立——部署时智能体需要从已安装的技能库中自行选择，并且经常携带此前工作中积累的记忆。我们提出了 SkillBuffBench，这是一个基准测试及配套的配对评估协议，它将技能访问视为一个三级因素（无技能、精选技能、以及从已安装库中自动调用），并与记忆（开启与关闭）、四个智能体框架以及多个模型（来自 Anthropic、Google 和 OpenAI 的最先进专有模型，以及来自中国厂商的最先进开源权重模型）进行交叉组合，每个模型都在每个框架下运行……
tldr: SkillBuffBench 通过将技能访问方式（无技能/精选技能/自动调用）、记忆开关、四个智能体框架和多个主流模型进行交叉配对评估，系统性地衡量了智能体技能在贴近真实部署场景下的实际贡献。
en_tdlr: SkillBuffBench is a benchmark with a paired evaluation protocol that systematically measures what Agent Skills actually contribute in realistic deployment settings by crossing three skill access modes, memory on/off, four agent harnesses, and multiple state-of-the-art proprietary and open-weight models.
